profile.headline: Software Engineer @ PayPal
profile.summary: A fast learning and motivated team player that looks at long term goals in decision making, development, and project management.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Digital Wallet and all the ways you use it!

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Saving you money now with PayPal too!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with external partners, client teams, and backend teams to aggregate data and provide that data quickly at scale. I worked on the proxy and authentication layer, third party api, response personalization, browse caching, search, ingestion, and many more smaller projects. I also lead the gameday push to identify pain points blocking scale through load testing, metrics with tracing, alexa app, and the inclusion of failover with short circuiting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed systems that track millions of physical parts and complex manufacturing activities in remote locations. Built systems that process massive amounts of data and engineering tools that enable rapid design and iteration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Was a direct contributor to the systems which process payments for digital goods from Amazon, including e-books, MP3s, Instant Video, mobile application/in-app purchases, Amazon Local, and Audible. Specific projects included diagnostic tooling, scaling for high volumes of traffic, feature development for international expansion across multiple storefronts, fraudulent customer detection, and ETL data processing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on projects that includes scalable back-end media infrastructure, web applications with complex interactive customer experiences, and external social or mobile clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on many projects ranging from a company website to standing up a custom international rental agreement platform based in Microsoft CRM.
